CFML Language Reference: Functions

ExpandPath

Converts a path relative to the directory of the base template, or a path starting with "/" that is relative to the web server's document root, into a full physical path on the server.

Category

System functions

Syntax

ExpandPath(relative_path)

Parameters

relative_path
A relative path such as "data.txt" or "images/logo.gif", or a root-relative path such as "/CFDOCS/index.htm".

Returns

The absolute path. The file or directory does not need to exist.

Usage

Relative paths are resolved against the directory of the base template (the page that was requested), not the included file or custom tag that calls ExpandPath. The result is ready for FileExists, CFFILE and CFDIRECTORY.

Paths are not tidied up: "." and ".." segments are passed through as they are.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Argument</TH><TH>ExpandPath()</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>"expandpath.cfm"</TD><TD>#ExpandPath("expandpath.cfm")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>"images/logo.gif"</TD><TD>#ExpandPath("images/logo.gif")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>"/CFDOCS/dochome.htm"</TD><TD>#ExpandPath("/CFDOCS/dochome.htm")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P>Does this page exist where ExpandPath says? #FileExists(ExpandPath("expandpath.cfm"))#
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetBaseTemplatePath, GetDirectoryFromPath, FileExists, CFFILE
